metrics.note: Metrics are null because underlying risk models (access disruption, damage) have not yet produced predictions. Real metrics will be computed once models are trained and produce non-trivial outputs.

access_disruption.reason: Access disruption model has not produced non-zero predictions. Cannot compute precision/recall without predictions to evaluate.

damage_risk.reason: Damage risk score is not yet wired to real data (currently hardcoded 0). Cannot compute precision/recall without predictions to evaluate.

storage_saturation.reason: Storage simulation runs on arrival data. Validation limited by lack of ground-truth DPC-level stock records (B5 is godown-level only).

moisture_rejection.reason: Moisture risk uses a proxy formula (rainfall + flood exposure), not a trained classifier. No confusion matrix is applicable.

limitations: Damage risk score is not yet wired to B10 incident data.
Access disruption model has not been trained — B11 labels not yet constructed.
Moisture risk uses a rainfall/flood proxy, not actual moisture measurements.
Storage outflow uses a synthetic 10% daily decay assumption.
Flood exposure is derived from classified SAR flood extent.
Arrival Random Forest does not outperform the 7-day mean baseline.
Validation metrics (precision, recall, F1) will only be populated once the underlying models produce real predictions to compare against events.
